# Generation 7 — Chesed Infinite Brainstorm

The Awtsmoos makes each public voice a star, each domain a vessel in the sea;
Awtsmoos.com should let crawler and human meet the same truthful page, wherever its DNS may be.

## Comments

- Make sitemap discoverability and renderer resolvability the same predicate.
- Detect stale alias pointers, moved comments, deleted comments, and mismatched post/heichel coordinates.
- Canonicalize moved comments to their living coordinates.
- Ensure replies, parents, imported/native bodies, and aliases remain crawlable without duplicate identities.
- Add a regression where the sitemap resolves a moved comment and the route renders the same body.
- Add a production-style audit that every comment sitemap URL returns indexable HTML or is omitted.
- Preserve noindex 404 semantics for truly missing comments.

## User-created websites and custom DNS

- Discover the one server boundary that resolves host/domain → published user site.
- Add SEO enrichment there so every eligible hosted HTML document gets defaults automatically.
- Canonical must use the actual public custom domain when the request is served through custom DNS.
- Awtsmoos-hosted aliases/subdomains should canonicalize to their own public identity unless the project explicitly selects another canonical domain.
- Preserve authored `<title>`, description, canonical, robots, OpenGraph, Twitter, and JSON-LD; fill only missing safe defaults.
- Never index unpublished/private/admin/editor/preview sites.
- Add per-site robots.txt and sitemap.xml behavior when the hosting system supports a project route inventory.
- If a custom domain is verified and primary, sitemap URLs and OG URLs should use that domain.
- Avoid duplicate domain identities by supporting primary-domain canonical preference.
- Derive safe fallback title from project/site/page metadata, never from secret owner data.
- Derive description from public project metadata or visible text only.
- Default schema to WebSite/WebPage, with no fabricated organization/person fields.
- Emit language/direction only when known or infer safely from authored document attributes.
- Add noindex defaults for preview/staging/tokenized/internal paths.
- Respect explicit user noindex.
- Strip unsafe canonical schemes and hostile host injection.
- Normalize host, port, forwarded host/proto only through trusted server configuration.
- Test custom DNS, Awtsmoos host, localhost, malformed Host, authored canonical, no head, multiple head/title tags, script-breaking text, Hebrew and RTL.
- Add automatic sitemap family for published project pages if the route model exposes them.
- Add index-health audit for hosted sites: published pages, canonicalized pages, sitemap coverage, noindex exclusions, broken pages.
- Add future Search Console ownership hooks only after the domain ownership system is understood.
